<!DOCTYPE html>

<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
:root{
  --primary:#6c63ff;
  --primary-dark:#574fd6;
  --dark:#0f0f0f;
  --darker:#080808;
  --card:#1a1a2e;
  --card2:#16213e;
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  --text:#e0e0e0;
  --muted:#888;
}
body{font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--darker);color:var(--text);overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6;}

/* REVEAL */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(32px);transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);}
.reveal.left{transform:translateX(-32px);}
.reveal.right{transform:translateX(32px);}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none;}
.d1{transition-delay:.1s;}.d2{transition-delay:.2s;}.d3{transition-delay:.3s;}.d4{transition-delay:.4s;}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;width:100%;z-index:999;padding:0 2rem;height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;transition:all .4s;}
nav.scrolled{background:rgba(8,8,8,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.logo{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;opacity:0;animation:fadeDown .6s .1s ease forwards;}
.logo span{color:var(--primary);}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2rem;align-items:center;opacity:0;animation:fadeDown .6s .2s ease forwards;}
.nav-links a{color:#aaa;text-decoration:none;font-size:.9rem;transition:.25s;}
.nav-links a:hover{color:#fff;}
.nav-cta{background:var(--primary);color:#fff!important;padding:.5rem 1.4rem;border-radius:50px;font-weight:600!important;transition:background .25s,transform .25s!important;}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--primary-dark)!important;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.hamburger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;}
.hamburger span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:#fff;border-radius:2px;transition:.3s;}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(45deg) translate(5px,5px);}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(5px,-5px);}
.mobile-menu{display:none;position:fixed;top:68px;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(8,8,8,.98);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.5rem 2rem;flex-direction:column;gap:0;z-index:998;}
.mobile-menu.open{display:flex;}
.mobile-menu a{color:#aaa;text-decoration:none;font-size:.95rem;padding:.9rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:.25s;}
.mobile-menu a:last-child{border:none;}
.mobile-menu a:hover{color:#fff;}

/* HERO */
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:100px 2rem 4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--darker);}
.hero-glow{position:absolute;width:600px;height:600px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(108,99,255,.15) 0%,transparent 70%);top:-100px;right:-100px;pointer-events:none;animation:glowPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite;}
.hero-glow2{position:absolute;width:400px;height:400px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(108,99,255,.08) 0%,transparent 70%);bottom:-50px;left:-50px;pointer-events:none;animation:glowPulse 8s ease-in-out infinite reverse;}
@keyframes glowPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.1);}}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 420px;gap:4rem;align-items:center;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;}
.hero-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);color:#a89fff;padding:.45rem 1.1rem;border-radius:50px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1.8rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .2s ease forwards;}
.hero-badge-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);animation:dotBlink 2s ease infinite;}
@keyframes dotBlink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:.3;}}
.hero-title{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,4.5rem);font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-1.5px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .3s ease forwards;}
.hero-title span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;}
.typed-wrap{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;}
.typed-el{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;}
.typed-cursor{display:inline-block;width:3px;height:.85em;background:var(--primary);margin-left:3px;vertical-align:middle;animation:cursorBlink .85s ease infinite;}
@keyframes cursorBlink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:0;}}
.hero-desc{color:#888;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.9;max-width:500px;margin-bottom:2.5rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .4s ease forwards;}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .5s ease forwards;}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),var(--primary-dark));color:#fff;padding:.85rem 2rem;border-radius:50px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;transition:.3s;display:inline-block;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(108,99,255,.3);}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(108,99,255,.5);}
.btn-outline{border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.4);color:#a89fff;padding:.85rem 2rem;border-radius:50px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;transition:.3s;display:inline-block;}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--primary);color:#fff;background:rgba(108,99,255,.1);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.btn-cv{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--border);color:#666;padding:.85rem 1.8rem;border-radius:50px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;transition:.3s;}
.btn-cv:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#ccc;transform:translateY(-3px);}
.btn-cv svg{transition:transform .3s;}
.btn-cv:hover svg{transform:translateY(2px);}
.hero-right{opacity:0;animation:fadeRight .9s .4s ease forwards;}
.hero-img-wrap{position:relative;}
.hero-img-glow{position:absolute;inset:-3px;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);opacity:.3;border-radius:26px;transition:.5s;}
.hero-img-wrap:hover .hero-img-glow{opacity:.5;}
.hero-img{width:100%;border-radius:24px;display:block;object-fit:cover;aspect-ratio:.82;object-position:top;position:relative;z-index:1;transition:transform .6s ease;}
.hero-img-wrap:hover .hero-img{transform:scale(1.02);}
.wa-wrap{margin-top:1.2rem;}
.wa-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.7rem;width:100%;padding:.82rem 1.5rem;border-radius:50px;border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.25);color:#aaa;text-decoration:none;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.4px;transition:.35s;background:transparent;}
.wa-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(37,211,102,.5);color:#4ade80;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.wa-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(37,211,102,.5);flex-shrink:0;animation:dotBlink 2.5s ease infinite;}
.wa-btn:hover .wa-dot{background:#4ade80;}
.wa-icon{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:#4ade80;}

/* STATS */
#stats{padding:4rem 2rem;background:var(--dark);border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2rem;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;}
.stat-num{font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;letter-spacing:-1px;}
.stat-label{font-size:.8rem;color:#555;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-top:.3rem;}

/* SECTIONS */
section{padding:6rem 2rem;}
.container{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;}
.section-tag{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--primary);margin-bottom:.8rem;}
.section-title{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.section-sub{color:#666;font-size:.97rem;max-width:520px;line-height:1.9;}
.section-header.center{text-align:center;}
.section-header.center .section-sub{margin:0 auto;}

/* SERVICES */
#services{background:var(--darker);}
.services-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:1.5rem;margin-top:3.5rem;}
.service-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:2rem;transition:.35s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.service-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);transform:scaleX(0);transition:.4s;transform-origin:left;}
.service-card:hover{border-color:rgba(108,99,255,.3);transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(108,99,255,.15);}
.service-card:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1);}
.service-icon{width:48px;height:48px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:1.2rem;transition:.3s;}
.service-card:hover .service-icon{background:rgba(108,99,255,.2);}
.service-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:var(--primary);}
.service-card h3{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.7rem;color:#e0e0e0;}
.service-card p{color:#666;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.8;flex:1;margin-bottom:1.5rem;}
.service-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;color:var(--primary);text-decoration:none;font-size:.83rem;font-weight:600;transition:.25s;align-self:flex-start;}
.service-link span{transition:transform .25s;}
.service-link:hover span{transform:translateX(4px);}

/* ABOUT */
#about{background:var(--dark);}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center;}
.about-img-wrap{position:relative;}
.about-img-border{position:absolute;inset:-3px;border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);opacity:.2;}
.about-img{width:100%;border-radius:24px;display:block;object-fit:cover;aspect-ratio:.9;object-position:top;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.about-text p{color:#666;line-height:1.95;font-size:.97rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem;}
.about-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem;margin-top:1.8rem;}
.chip{background:rgba(108,99,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:#a89fff;padding:.4rem .95rem;border-radius:50px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.4px;transition:.3s;cursor:default;}
.chip:hover{background:rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.mission-vision{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;margin-top:2rem;}
.mv-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:1.3rem;transition:.3s;}
.mv-card:hover{border-color:rgba(108,99,255,.3);}
.mv-card h4{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);margin-bottom:.4rem;}
.mv-card p{color:#555;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.7;}

/* SKILLS */
#skills{background:var(--darker);}
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:3.5rem;}
.skill-card{background:var(--card);padding:1.8rem 2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.2rem;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.skill-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(108,99,255,.04);transform:translateX(-100%);transition:.45s ease;}
.skill-card:hover::after{transform:translateX(0);}
.skill-card:hover{background:var(--card2);}
.skill-card:hover .skill-arrow{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}
.skill-card:hover .skill-icon-box{border-color:rgba(108,99,255,.4);background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);}
.skill-icon-box{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;transition:.3s;}
.skill-icon-box svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:var(--primary);}
.skill-info h4{font-size:.93rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.2rem;color:#ccc;}
.skill-info p{color:#555;font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.5;}
.skill-arrow{position:absolute;right:1.4rem;color:var(--primary);font-size:.85rem;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);transition:.3s;font-style:normal;}

/* FEATURES */
#features{background:var(--dark);}
.features-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center;}
.features-list{list-style:none;margin-top:1.5rem;}
.features-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;color:#888;font-size:.95rem;padding:.7rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.features-list li:last-child{border:none;}
.check{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.check svg{width:10px;height:10px;stroke:var(--primary);}
.features-img-wrap{position:relative;}
.features-img-glow{position:absolute;inset:-3px;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),#a89fff);opacity:.15;}
.features-img{width:100%;border-radius:22px;display:block;object-fit:cover;aspect-ratio:.9;object-position:top;position:relative;z-index:1;}

/* CTA */
#cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(108,99,255,.15),rgba(108,99,255,.05));border-top:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);}
.cta-inner{max-width:700px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;}
.cta-inner h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:1rem;letter-spacing:-.5px;}
.cta-inner p{color:#666;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.9;margin-bottom:2.5rem;}
.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;}

/* CONTACT */
#contact{background:var(--darker);}
.contact-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:start;}
.contact-left h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.7rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.contact-left p{color:#666;font-size:.97rem;line-height:1.95;margin-bottom:2.2rem;}
.contact-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.9rem;}
.cinfo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;transition:.3s;padding:.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.cinfo:last-child{border:none;}
.cinfo:hover{transform:translateX(4px);}
.cinfo-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);background:rgba(108,99,255,.08);border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;transition:.3s;}
.cinfo-icon svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--primary);}
.cinfo:hover .cinfo-icon{border-color:rgba(108,99,255,.4);background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);}
.cinfo-text{font-size:.88rem;color:#666;}
.cinfo-text a{color:#666;text-decoration:none;transition:.2s;}
.cinfo-text a:hover{color:#a89fff;}
.social-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:1.1rem 1.4rem;text-decoration:none;color:#666;transition:.35s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.9rem;}
.social-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(108,99,255,.04);transform:translateX(-100%);transition:.45s ease;}
.social-btn:hover::before{transform:translateX(0);}
.social-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(108,99,255,.3);color:#a89fff;transform:translateX(5px);}
.social-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid var(--border);}
.social-icon img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
.social-icon-plain{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);background:rgba(108,99,255,.08);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.social-icon-plain svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:var(--primary);}
.social-text{flex:1;}
.social-name{font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:.12rem;color:#888;transition:.3s;}
.social-btn:hover .social-name{color:#a89fff;}
.social-handle{font-size:.77rem;color:#444;}
.social-arrow{color:#333;font-size:.85rem;transition:.3s;font-style:normal;}
.social-btn:hover .social-arrow{color:var(--primary);transform:translateX(3px);}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--dark);border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:3rem 2rem;}
.footer-inner{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;}
.footer-brand p{color:#444;font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.8;margin-top:.8rem;max-width:280px;}
.footer-col h4{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:#888;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-bottom:1.2rem;}
.footer-col a{display:block;color:#444;text-decoration:none;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:.6rem;transition:.2s;}
.footer-col a:hover{color:#a89fff;}
.footer-bottom{max-width:1100px;margin:2rem auto 0;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;}
.footer-bottom p{color:#333;font-size:.82rem;}
.footer-bottom span{color:#555;}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fadeDown{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fadeRight{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(40px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}}

/* HERO LABEL ABOVE */
.hero-label-above{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;opacity:0;animation:labelSlideIn .8s .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) forwards;}
.hla-text{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a89fff;white-space:nowrap;}
.hla-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(108,99,255,.5),transparent);}
@keyframes labelSlideIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px);}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}

/* HERO NAME OVER */
.hero-name-over{text-align:center;font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a89fff,#6c63ff);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:0;animation:labelSlideIn .8s .7s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) forwards;}

/* CURSOR */
.cursor-glow{position:fixed;width:350px;height:350px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(108,99,255,.04) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:left .15s,top .15s;left:-500px;top:-500px;}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:920px){
  .hero-grid,.about-grid,.features-grid,.contact-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3rem;}
  .hero-right,.features-img-wrap{max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;}
  .hero-right{order:-1;}
  .hero-title{font-size:2.8rem;}
  .hero-btns{justify-content:center;}
  .stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .footer-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .nav-links{display:none;}
  .hamburger{display:flex;}
  .mission-vision{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  nav,section,footer{padding-left:1.4rem;padding-right:1.4rem;}
  section{padding-top:4rem;padding-bottom:4rem;}
  .btn-primary,.btn-outline,.btn-cv{width:100%;text-align:center;justify-content:center;}
  .hero-btns{flex-direction:column;}
  .stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .footer-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .footer-bottom{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="cursor-glow" id="cursorGlow"></div>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="navbar">
  <a href="#" class="logo">Karthik<span>.</span></a>

    <a href="#services">Services</a>

    <a href="#skills">Skills</a>
    <a href="#features">Features</a>

  </div>
  <div class="hamburger" id="hamburger"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
</nav>

  <a href="#about">About</a>
  <a href="#skills">Skills</a>
  <a href="#features">Features</a>
  <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
</div>

<!-- HERO -->
<section id="hero">
  <div class="hero-glow"></div>
  <div class="hero-glow2"></div>
  <div class="hero-grid">

<script>
// Typing animation
const words=['the Best Ever','My Passion','the Future','Results Driven'];
let wi=0,ci=0,del=false;
const el=document.getElementById('typedEl');
function type(){
  const w=words[wi];
  if(!del){el.textContent=w.slice(0,++ci);if(ci===w.length){del=true;setTimeout(type,2000);return;}}
  else{el.textContent=w.slice(0,--ci);if(ci===0){del=false;wi=(wi+1)%words.length;}}
  setTimeout(type,del?55:105);
}
setTimeout(type,1200);

// Scroll reveal
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');obs.unobserve(e.target);}});
},{threshold:.1,rootMargin:'0px 0px -50px 0px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(r=>obs.observe(r));

// Nav scroll
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  document.getElementById('navbar').classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>40);
});

// Hamburger
const ham=document.getElementById('hamburger'),menu=document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
ham.addEventListener('click',()=>{ham.classList.toggle('open');menu.classList.toggle('open');});
menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{ham.classList.remove('open');menu.classList.remove('open');}));

// Cursor glow
const glow=document.getElementById('cursorGlow');
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{glow.style.left=e.clientX+'px';glow.style.top=e.clientY+'px';});

// Counter animation
const cObs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      const t=+e.target.dataset.target,inc=t/50;
      let c=0;
      const timer=setInterval(()=>{c+=inc;if(c>=t){c=t;clearInterval(timer);}e.target.textContent=Math.ceil(c)+'+';},28);
      cObs.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
},{threshold:.6});
document.querySelectorAll('.stat-num').forEach(n=>cObs.observe(n));
</script>
</body>
</html>
